verdict.rationale: Square ships an in-product AI assistant (Square AI), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question here, but nothing in the evidence shows Square AI or any other part of Square acting as an MCP client. The documented Square MCP server is the opposite role: it exposes Square's APIs to outside AI tools such as Claude, Cursor and Goose. It does not let Square consume tools from other servers, so it is not credited here.
